_note: One-line economic definitions for the field pool (JKP/Kelly-153 abbreviations + price/volume cores). Curated from standard JKP / Chen-Zimmermann characteristic definitions; swap in the official JKP 'Factor Details' text if you have it. Injected into the LLM prompt by adapter/run_sp500.py build_scenario().
me: Market equity (size = price x shares outstanding).
age: Firm age in months since first data appearance.
aliq_at: Balance-sheet liquidity of assets, scaled by total assets.
ami_126d: Amihud illiquidity: price impact per dollar volume (126-day).
at_be: Total assets to book equity (book leverage).
at_gr1: One-year growth in total assets (asset growth / investment).
at_me: Total assets to market equity (assets-to-market value).
at_turnover: Asset turnover: sales divided by total assets.
be_gr1a: One-year change in book equity, scaled by assets.
be_me: Book equity to market equity (book-to-market, value).
beta_60m: Market beta from a 60-month rolling regression.
beta_dimson_21d: Dimson market beta with lead-lag correction (21-day).
betadown_252d: Downside market beta estimated on down-market days (252-day).
bev_mev: Book enterprise value to market enterprise value.
cash_at: Cash and short-term investments to total assets.
chcsho_12m: 12-month change in shares outstanding (net share issuance).
coa_gr1a: Change in current operating assets, scaled by assets.
col_gr1a: Change in current operating liabilities, scaled by assets.
cop_at: Cash-based operating profits to total assets.
cop_atl1: Cash-based operating profits to lagged total assets.
corr_1260d: Correlation of the stock with the market (1260-day).
coskew_21d: Coskewness of returns with the market (21-day).
dbnetis_at: Net debt issuance to total assets.
dgp_dsale: Gross-profit growth in excess of sales growth.
div12m_me: Trailing 12-month dividends to market equity (dividend yield).
dsale_drec: Sales growth in excess of accounts-receivable growth.
emp_gr1: One-year growth in the number of employees.
eq_dur: Equity duration (cash-flow-weighted horizon of equity value).
eqnetis_at: Net equity issuance to total assets.
eqnpo_12m: Net equity payout over 12 months (issuance minus payout).
eqnpo_me: Net equity payout yield relative to market equity.
fcf_me: Free cash flow to market equity.
fnl_gr1a: Change in financial liabilities, scaled by assets.
gp_at: Gross profits to total assets (gross profitability).
gp_atl1: Gross profits to lagged total assets.
inv_gr1a: Change in inventory, scaled by assets.
ncoa_gr1a: Change in non-current operating assets, scaled by assets.
ncol_gr1a: Change in non-current operating liabilities, scaled by assets.
netis_at: Net total (equity plus debt) issuance to total assets.
nfna_gr1a: Change in net financial assets, scaled by assets.
ni_ar1: Earnings persistence (AR(1) coefficient of net income).
ni_be: Net income to book equity (return on equity).
ni_inc8q: Number of consecutive quarters (up to 8) of earnings increases.
ni_ivol: Idiosyncratic volatility of net income (earnings volatility).
ni_me: Net income to market equity (earnings yield).
niq_at: Quarterly net income to total assets (quarterly ROA).
niq_be: Quarterly net income to book equity (quarterly ROE).
noa_at: Net operating assets to total assets.
oaccruals_ni: Operating accruals to net income (accrual quality).
ocf_at: Operating cash flow to total assets.
ocf_at_chg1: One-year change in operating cash flow to assets.
ocf_me: Operating cash flow to market equity (cash-flow yield).
op_at: Operating profits to total assets (operating profitability).
op_atl1: Operating profits to lagged total assets.
pi_nix: Pretax income relative to net income (tax burden).
prc_highprc_252d: Current price relative to its 52-week high.
ret_12_1: Price momentum: return from month 12 to 2 (skip last month).
ret_12_7: Intermediate momentum: return from month 12 to 7.
ret_1_0: Short-term reversal: most recent one-month return.
ret_60_12: Long-term reversal: return from month 60 to 13.
rmax1_21d: Maximum single daily return over 21 days (lottery/MAX).
rmax5_21d: Average of the five highest daily returns over 21 days.
rmax5_rvol_21d: Average of five highest daily returns scaled by realized volatility (21-day).
rvol_21d: Realized total volatility of daily returns (21-day).
sale_emp_gr1: One-year growth in sales per employee.
seas_1_1an: Average same-calendar-month return one year ago (seasonal).
seas_1_1na: Average non-same-month return over the prior year (non-seasonal).
tax_gr1a: Change in taxes payable, scaled by assets.
zero_trades_126d: Frequency of zero-volume trading days (126-day illiquidity).
